title: Intelligent cost estimation for an ERP

images.alt: Architecture diagram: model development pipeline, integration layer, and the ERP web application flow
images.caption: System architecture from the thesis.

summary: An Owner Estimate Cost (OEC) estimation feature for a project-management ERP, built by comparing seven algorithms on 110 real transactions.
points: Linear Regression, SVR, Ridge, Random Forest, XGBoost, ANN, and Moving Average, ranked with Borda Count.
Segmented Linear Regression was selected: R² 0.77, MAPE 10.7%.
Integrated into the Laravel backend with 112 ms inference latency.
